scope: Optional CPU owner diagnostics only; frozen production and integration source, existing focused host evidence, local ESP-IDF kernel source. No target build, hardware access, test re-execution, or production modification.

working_tree.note: Concurrent unrelated capture-tool/config-auditor work remains; whole-tree freeze is not asserted.

checks.detail: Only CPU0 owner checkpoints sample their current task with vTaskGetInfo(NULL,pdFALSE,eReady). No retained TaskHandle_t/name/stack pointers, allocation, stack walk, idle/SDK task lookup, or new task is introduced.

Short DRAM task-context mux covers published records. Timer/kernel calls and formatting occur outside that mux. Actual IDF dual-core vTaskGetInfo copies the U64 accumulator under the same xKernelLock used for switch-out accounting. Unsupported SMP/UNICORE/non-U64/non-ESP_TIMER configurations are rejected.

checks.topic: single writer violations and counter regressions
checks.detail: Overlapping sampling or changed sampled task number latches writer_conflict. Lower runtime or sampler time regression latches unavailable until reboot. Conflict is not cleared by later valid publication. Task/counter comparison is boot-session scoped.

Query copies a coherent record under mux, then reads clock. It cannot underflow age from a newer simultaneous publication. If the copied observation is in the query clock future, that returned snapshot has age unknown, clockRegressed=true and available=false; query does not mutate owner state.

Actual port casts esp_timer_get_time directly to U64 and the accumulator is U64; no intermediate U32 timer truncation. Report is a completed-switch-out accumulator that excludes the currently open slice and may include ISR/non-SDK work. No CPU percentage, SDK-only runtime, or wall-minus-run blocked time is claimed.

Strict CPUOWNER?0..6, bounded snprintf, unknown runtime for disabled/unobserved/conflicted/regressed state. Stale historical samples remain explicitly stale and are not interpreted as zero current consumption. Other-agent host log: largest owner response372bytes and PROTO465bytes within512; target stack/format execution not run by reviewer.

OFF removes observer include/call and sample storage. ON adds owner observation only before unchanged WorkBudget predicates; no delay, idle-hook modification, watchdog feed, threshold change, or pacing policy change. Observation and globally enabled FreeRTOS runtime accounting have nonzero time/RAM costs; fixed-fake-clock host budget equivalence is not HIL performance equivalence.

Default off, explicit supported-kernel/clock dependencies, readonly early and normal dispatch, cpu_owner_v1 capability. No setters, Applied identity, frontend state transitions, or scientific encoder changes.

checks.detail: timerCalls is now _Atomic unsigned and test file hash matches the final focused host manifest. No production source change was requested for this harness-only issue.
